title: 番外林灵第3章 灵寄番外林灵第2章 守渡
content_zh:
吴朝云等十人顿时路出一丝羡慕之色，但是也没有多言。接下来两方二十人就走向一栋宽大的建筑之中。
身受重伤的天锋脚下一个趔趄，差点摔到地面上。眼中明显闪过复杂之色，不再理会其他人，扭头向着一个方向飞去，只是飞的歪歪斜斜，看着有些凄凉。
眼圈通红的鸣人，心情沮丧、压抑、悲伤、愤怒皆有，开口质问。
幸运就像是烙饼一样，要用力去揉，用油去煎，用火去烤，绝不会从天上掉下来。
再度伸长的雷神剑，穿透角都另一个想要逃跑的面具怪…短短几分钟内，他的四个心脏竟然全部阵亡了。
那个时候根本没有多想，后来变陡然间觉得自己浑身没有了力气，也不知道是什么情况。
随着时间的流失，留在冬林山脉的选手越来越少，一个月后，这片战场上，只剩下不到二十人。而现在淘汰最多选手的辉龙，也不过才淘汰了二十六名选手。
第一只还没收拾完，现在居然出现了第二只，这打乱了宗方的一切安排计划。
我能明显的看出来，吕轻侯的语气并非是很好，但为父之命也不好违抗。也只能心不甘情不愿的走出了房门，去叫吕萌萌去了。
有时候我就在想，如果我国没有遇到外国入侵这样的，清朝以后的朝代会如何发展呢？
随着一个不甘心的声音传来，一个冰凉的大手已然贴在了古昊的脑门。
当达无悔觉得自己把九狱山飞行一圈后，也没有找到梦妃说的三木山，达无悔头大了，他想到一个可能。
梦妃忽然突兀的消失在这个星空之中，仿佛这个星空没有出现过她一样。
“废话少说，本大王是不会放弃的！”飞天神蟒蛇口气还是一如既往的坚定。
不用再多想，窦氏此时也明白那鞋是谁做的了，若不然怎么才一接下侯府的鞋，人就忍不住去探望那个元娘，平日里她可不觉得她们姐妹感情好。
“福生！你说昨天怎么回事！？有这个门路你怎么不把我们都带上，害得我们都晚上了才到家。”付玉波兴师问罪来了。
想到这里，古昊搓了搓手，而后便推开门，轻轻关上，看了看四周，便下了楼。
天地间风云变色，元气风暴肆孽席卷，一些修为低下的妖兽，都浑身颤抖的躲在洞穴之内，有些甚至被吓的失禁。
天妖帝国发兵侵犯大陆各国，冥冥中似乎就是一个导火索，牵引着一系列不寻常事件逐步出现在大陆生灵面前。
以为上次之事冬雪会长些记性，如今看来狗改不了吃屎，自己对她的期望还是过高了。

李智贤娇喝一声：“看招！”右掌一挥，一粒石子飞出，李堡主不愿避让，挥剑一磕，发出“当”的一声，声音悦耳，只是功力远不如先前击落黄寨主雁翎刀的那人，或许对方故意在隐藏实力。
犹如一位溺水的人，在万般无助之际，突然发现了远处的水面上漂浮着一根稻草。
一柱香后，柳晗烟的身子微微动了一下，王厚脸上一喜，知道此法有了收效，不敢大意，继续运功驱毒。
“恭喜大哥！”山山起立恭喜。的确，修仙者是一个大门派的根基，培养修仙者是很重要的门派任务。
不过到底是魔修，脑袋一转就想出了坏主意，装模作样道：“先不采你了，你先呆着罢！”从囊中掏出一包药，扑在月华脸上；剩了一点，就随便下在清心脸上。
鹤万年被酒意所弄，更加得意，身形变化，使出一招‘苏秦背剑’，将双镖自身后射出，又中两只，亦惹下一片哄声。
大汉带着手下乘机逃走，左手一抬，飞刀刺入大汉的大腿，一声惨叫，他的鱼虾之众也都撇下了他，头也不回地逃命去了。
庄昭雪拉过柳晗烟，连声称赞众人的轻功了得，王厚将手向庄昭雪面前一伸，庄昭雪这才发现一只怪头盯着自己，尖牙圆眼，发着吱吱的威胁声，直吓得连退几步。
而在将这里的事情处理完了后，叶燕青一行人便离开了这里回到了紫荆关中。
陈君毅立刻从墙壁中出来，然后手中的那些本来是i金属球的i金属，不断的构造，绳子，还有手铐，几乎所有能够限制人行动的东西瞬间就出现在了夏春秋身上，将夏春秋完全的限制了起来。
“诸位，杀了这厮容易，不过朝廷已经派出了兵马支援边关，或许不到半个月就要抵达，若是追究起来，我等都没有好结果。”王大恶人说道。
“这风好强烈！陈晨准备好，一会看到我出手后你就跟上。”林可心紧握着手中的佩剑说道。
他还以为以安晓晓的性子，会先脸红一会儿呢，好让他可以欣赏一下那可爱的境况呢，现在没好戏看了。
相对来说九十一号的武器更长，所以要是开始的时候双方同时出招的话，应该是自己这边更加的占优势才对，九十一号已经开始了分析，下一秒，冬的身体动了。
说完，那清虚公子将手中的剑直指对面的血一刀的门心，面对这这一剑血一刀将自己的气势发挥到了极致然后想直接将清虚公子震飞，然而让他没想到的是这看似随意的一剑竟也是对方的全力一击。
“不是……”车夫声音已经明显有了颤抖，虽不解于为何今天的主子会有如此决定，但按照规矩，平民百姓若是阻拦官车，即使是乱棍打死也行，更何况，他只是依令把车驾过去呢？

content_en:
Wu Chaoyun and the other ten people suddenly showed a look of envy, but they didn't say much. Next, twenty people from both parties walked towards a large building.
Tian Feng, who was seriously injured, staggered and almost fell to the ground. A complex look clearly flashed in his eyes, and he ignored the others and turned his head to fly in one direction, but he flew crookedly and looked a bit miserable.
Naruto, whose eyes were red, feeling frustrated, depressed, sad, and angry, asked.
Luck is like pancakes. You have to knead them hard, fry them with oil, and bake them with fire. They will never fall from the sky.
The Thunder God Sword was extended again and penetrated another masked monster in Kakuzu who was trying to escape... In just a few minutes, all four of his hearts were killed.
I didn't think much about it at that time, but then I suddenly felt like I had no strength in my body, and I didn't know what was going on.
As time went by, fewer and fewer players remained in the Donglin Mountains. A month later, there were less than twenty people left on this battlefield. And Huilong, who has eliminated the most players now, has only eliminated 26 players.
The first one hasn't been taken care of yet, and now the second one actually appears, which disrupts all Zongfang's plans.
I can clearly see that Lu Qinghou's tone is not very good, but it is not easy to disobey his father's orders. I could only reluctantly walk out of the room and go call Lu Mengmeng.
Sometimes I wonder, if our country had not encountered foreign invasion, how would the dynasties after the Qing Dynasty develop?
As a reluctant voice came, a big cold hand was already placed on Gu Hao's forehead.
When Da Wuhui felt that after flying around Jiujing Mountain, he still couldn't find the Sanmu Mountain that Meng Fei mentioned. Da Wuhui felt dizzy and thought of a possibility.
Meng Fei suddenly disappeared into the starry sky, as if she had never appeared in the starry sky.
"Stop talking nonsense, this king will not give up!" The Flying God Python's tone was as firm as ever.
No need to think anymore, Mrs. Dou now understood who made the shoes. Otherwise, as soon as she took the shoes from the Hou Mansion, people couldn't help but visit Yuanniang. Normally, she didn't think their sisters had a good relationship.
"Fusheng! What did you say happened yesterday? Why didn't you bring us all with you if you have such a good connection? We didn't get home until late at night." Fu Yubo came to investigate.
Thinking of this, Gu Hao rubbed his hands, then pushed the door open, closed it gently, looked around, and then went downstairs.
The situation in the world changed, and the vitality storm swept across violently. Some monsters with low cultivation levels trembled and hid in the caves, and some were even frightened to the point of incontinence.
The Sky Demon Empire sent troops to invade various countries on the mainland, which seemed to be a trigger, leading a series of unusual events to gradually appear in front of the creatures on the mainland.
I thought Dongxue would have a better memory of what happened last time, but now it seems that dogs can't change their ways of eating shit, so my expectations for her are still too high.
Li Zhixian shouted: "Watch the move!" He waved his right palm, and a stone flew out. Lord Li did not want to get out of the way, so he swung his sword and made a "dang" sound. The sound was pleasant, but his skill was far inferior to that of the man who shot down Huang Zhai Lord's Yanling Saber before. Perhaps the other party was deliberately hiding his strength.
Just like a drowning person, when he is helpless, he suddenly finds a straw floating on the water in the distance.
After blowing the incense stick, Liu Hanyan's body moved slightly, and Wang Hou's face was filled with joy. He knew that this method was effective, so he did not dare to be careless and continued to use his energy to expel poison.
"Congratulations, brother!" Shanshan stood up to congratulate. Indeed, immortal cultivators are the foundation of a sect, and cultivating immortal cultivators is a very important sect task.
But after all, he was a demon cultivator. He came up with a bad idea in a flash and pretended to say: "I won't pick you up for now. Just stay here!" He took out a pack of medicine from his bag and threw it on Yuehua's face. If there was a little left, he poured it on Qingxin's face.He Wannian became even more complacent due to his drunkenness. He changed his body shape and used the move "Su Qin Back Sword" to shoot the two darts behind him and hit two more, which also caused a roar.
The big man took the opportunity to escape with his men. He raised his left hand and the flying knife pierced the big man's thigh. With a scream, all his fish and shrimps also abandoned him and fled for their lives without looking back.
Zhuang Zhaoxue pulled Liu Hanyan and praised everyone's lightness skills repeatedly. Wang Hou stretched out his hand in front of Zhuang Zhaoxue. Only then did Zhuang Zhaoxue find a strange head staring at him, with fangs and round eyes, making a squeaky threatening sound, and he was so frightened that he took a few steps back.
After settling the matters here, Ye Yanqing and his party left here and returned to Zijingguan.
Chen Junyi immediately came out of the wall, and then the i-metal in his hand, which was originally an i-metal ball, continuous structures, ropes, and handcuffs, almost everything that could restrict a person's movement appeared on Xia Chunqiu in an instant, completely restricting Xia Chunqiu.
"Everyone, it's easy to kill this guy, but the imperial court has sent troops and horses to support the border. They may arrive in less than half a month. If we pursue it, we won't have any good results." The evil man Wang said.
"This wind is so strong! Chen Chen, be ready. You will follow me as soon as you see me take action." Lin Kexin said, holding the sword in her hand tightly.
He thought that with An Xiaoxiao's temperament, he would blush for a while so that he could appreciate the lovely situation, but now it's no good.
Relatively speaking, No. 91's weapon is longer, so if both sides attack at the same time at the beginning, his side should have the advantage. No. 91 has already begun analysis, and the next second, Dong's body moves.
After saying that, Master Qingxu pointed the sword in his hand directly at the door of Xue Yida opposite him. Facing this sword, Xue Yida exerted his momentum to the extreme and wanted to knock Master Qingxu away. However, what he didn't expect was that this seemingly random sword was also a full blow from the opponent.
"No..." The coachman's voice was obviously trembling. Although he didn't understand why today's master would make such a decision, according to the rules, if civilians blocked an official car, they could be beaten to death with sticks. What's more, he just drove the car over according to the order?
